decisions.decision: Aggregate distinct roles per entity at build time from data/entity_links.json
decisions.rationale: Backend export leaves entity.roles empty for all 92k entities, so the Pagefind index had no role facet dimension. Build-time aggregation gives us a working role facet without waiting for the backend to populate the field.

decisions.decision: Add century and decade Pagefind filter spans per entity
decisions.rationale: Year-only spans inflated century counts because a 60-year-lived entity contributed 60 to its century total. Dedicated single-occurrence-per-bucket filters give accurate unique-entity counts at each aggregation level.

decisions.decision: Pivot from viewport-filling app shell to scroll-page 3-column layout
decisions.rationale: Per user request after seeing EntityExplorerRefinedPage in Figma Make. New structure: filters (280px) | results (flex) | selected entity (320px sticky), with the graph as a 450px panel above the columns.

decisions.decision: Drop .container class from explorer-page wrapper and apply max-width directly
decisions.rationale: Tailwind v4's .container utility lives in @layer utilities and beats any component-layer rule regardless of selector specificity. Standalone class is the only reliable workaround.

decisions.decision: Replace requestAnimationFrame await with setTimeout in entity-explorer.search()
decisions.rationale: rAF is paused in hidden tabs, leaving the explorer permanently stuck on the loading spinner when users open /entidades/ in a background tab.

decisions.decision: Skip Pagefind entirely for the viewport-only render path
decisions.rationale: An unfiltered/unsorted query on the 92k entity index blocks the WASM thread for tens of seconds even without sort. The visible viewport is at most ~100 entities, so synthesising Pagefind-style hit objects from getVisibleEntities is dramatically faster.

decisions.decision: Drop default sort from parseUrlParams (move count:desc default into search() proper)
decisions.rationale: Default sort caused the pre-search guard to fail and triggered a full 92k WASM sort on initial page load (~40s freeze). Default sort still applies for real searches, just not on the empty browse-prompt state.

decisions.decision: Render role facet as checkbox group in left sidebar instead of pill bar above results
decisions.rationale: User feedback: roles should match the visual language of type/date facets. Multi-select preserved via activeRoles set.

context_notes: Massive day. Started by closing out the previously paused 10.1-04 verification (browser hang on /entidades/).
